description:
runtime/src/any_value.rs has raw_alloc (16-aligned std::alloc, never freed) and pub fn alloc_struct built on it. Their only callers are runtime/src/any_value_test.rs (alloc_struct at lines 45, 59, 309 at 52ad3bf47) and the cfg(test) alloc_list_cons_raw_kind. Production code never calls them, yet they are compiled into the runtime and alloc_struct is public.

Done when: raw_alloc and alloc_struct live behind cfg(test) (or in the test module), nothing outside tests can name them, and the test callers still pass. If a test can use a real Heap instead of a leaking allocation, prefer that. Done when also: comments are plain present-tense facts with no ticket numbers; full gate green (cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace --all-targets --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1; cargo test --workspace --doc); no pin or golden moves; commit in Why / What changed / Verification form; no co-author trailer, no attribution line.
title: Leaking test allocators leave the shipping runtime
